verification: each control's module and report are checked to exist in the repository

controls.title: Risk management processes are documented and traceable
controls.evidence: Every claim in this repository is produced by a command, written to a report, and regenerated by `netsentry analyze`; the release gate encodes the definition of done as an executable check rather than a checklist.

controls.title: Ongoing monitoring and periodic review are planned
controls.evidence: Drift monitoring (PSI, KS+BH, kernel two-sample), SLO burn-rate alerting whose Prometheus rules are generated from the measured operating point, and a priced retrain policy comparing never / periodic / drift-triggered.

controls.title: A culture of risk identification is fostered; negative results are recorded
controls.evidence: NOTES.md is a running self-audit of failures, wrong predictions and bugs found before release; several studies are kept specifically because their result was negative (cascade, defer, discovery, strategic, acquisition).

controls.title: Third-party software and data risks are managed
controls.evidence: A CycloneDX SBOM with Package URLs, a signed model-integrity manifest, and a `verify` gate that exits non-zero when the artifact's bytes change.

controls.title: Intended purpose, context and limits are understood and documented
controls.evidence: The model card states the intended use, the operating point, and the limits; the architecture document has an explicit out-of-scope section.

controls.title: Scientific integrity and TEVV considerations are documented
controls.evidence: The headline evaluation is a temporal split with the optimistic stratified number reported beside it, and the leakage study reproduces the field's ~99% result to price each source of it.

controls.title: Likelihood and magnitude of each impact are understood
controls.evidence: Cost-sensitive thresholds put a currency on false positives and negatives; the base-rate study shows what alert precision does at production prevalence; the queue simulation puts the analyst in the loop.

controls.title: System performance is demonstrated in deployment-like conditions
controls.evidence: Detection is reported at fixed false-positive budgets on a temporal split whose test days share no attack class with training, plus a cross-dataset transfer study and a per-service parity audit.

controls.title: Validity and reliability are demonstrated, including uncertainty
controls.evidence: Bootstrap confidence intervals, a cross-seed noise floor, conformal prediction sets, epistemic/aleatoric decomposition, and distribution-free risk control with its expectation-versus-tail distinction measured.

controls.title: Security and resilience are evaluated
controls.evidence: Evasion, poisoning, backdoor, membership-inference, extraction and watermarking studies, governed as one threat model against MITRE ATLAS with the residual gaps named rather than omitted.

controls.title: Fairness and bias across relevant groups are evaluated
controls.evidence: Per-service detection parity is audited with Wilson intervals and served as a `per_service` threshold profile, and automatic slice discovery searches for underperforming regions nobody predefined. Both are *operational* groupings; this system processes no personal attributes, so demographic fairness is not assessed and no claim about it should be inferred.

controls.title: Effectiveness of the measurement approach itself is assessed
controls.evidence: Metamorphic testing provides a label-free correctness oracle, validated by a three-oracle mutation study in which none of labelled accuracy, invariants or the canary dominates the others.

controls.title: Mechanisms are in place to sustain the value of deployed systems
controls.evidence: Champion/challenger promotion with paired-bootstrap margins from the measured noise floor, shadow scoring on live traffic, canary-gated hot reload, and threshold refresh priced against retraining.

controls.title: Post-deployment monitoring plans are implemented, including incident response
controls.evidence: Drift monitors, SLO burn-rate alerts and incident reports exist and are wired to Prometheus; what does not exist is an organisational response *plan* — who is paged, what authority they have, and how a rollback is authorised are outside what a repository can evidence.

controls.title: Risk management system across the lifecycle
controls.evidence: Risks are identified, measured and re-measured after mitigation throughout (measure - fix - re-measure appears in hardening, poisoning defence and the control-loop attack). What is missing is the formal artifact: a maintained risk register with owners and residual-risk acceptance, which is a governance document rather than a study.

controls.title: Data governance: relevance, representativeness, errors and gaps examined
controls.evidence: The data card documents provenance, known defects and the label consolidation; validation gates enforce schema, label and duplicate checks; the label audit uses confident learning and self-validates on planted flips.

controls.title: Technical documentation sufficient to assess conformity
controls.evidence: An auto-generated model card, an architecture document, a data card, and reports produced by the same commands that produced the numbers in them.

controls.title: Automatic recording of events (logging) over the system's lifetime
controls.evidence: A hash-chained, tamper-evident alert ledger with a published anchor closing the tail-truncation gap and O(log n) Merkle inclusion proofs, so an alert history can be attested without being disclosed. Six tamper attacks are executed against it.

controls.title: Transparency: operation interpretable enough for the deployer to use output
controls.evidence: Every prediction carries SHAP attributions, a MITRE technique, a conformal prediction set and a recommended action; anomaly flags carry their own attribution; nearest known training flows are available as evidence.

controls.title: Human oversight: designed so a person can intervene and override
controls.evidence: The system routes rather than acts: conformal sets produce auto-alert / auto-clear / review actions, learning-to-defer prices escalation against analyst capacity, and alert-queue planning sizes the human budget. It does not implement an override *interface* or record who overrode what, which is a product surface this repository does not have.

controls.title: Appropriate accuracy, declared with its metrics
controls.evidence: Accuracy is banned from the headline; detection is declared at fixed false-positive budgets with certified budgets from an order statistic and the sample-size floor below which no threshold can certify one.

controls.title: Resilience to errors, faults and inconsistencies
controls.evidence: A sensor-failure audit runs the deployed model against a broken exporter; monotone constraints make an entire evasion family impossible by construction; interval-arithmetic verification gives a sound absolute robustness radius.

controls.title: Resilience to attempts to alter use, outputs or performance
controls.evidence: Data poisoning and backdoor attacks with defences re-measured, model extraction and its transfer evasion, membership inference with a differential-privacy answer priced, and byte-level artifact attestation at load and at deploy.

controls.title: Quality management system
controls.evidence: No quality management system exists here, and one cannot: Article 17 is about an organisation's documented procedures, responsibilities and change control, not about code. The CI pipeline and release gate are inputs to such a system, not a substitute for it.

controls.title: Fundamental rights impact assessment
controls.evidence: Required of deployers in specific public-body and essential-service contexts. This repository is a reference implementation with no deployer and no affected persons; the assessment belongs to whoever deploys it, and the data card's statement that flow records identify people is the input they would start from.

controls.title: Conformity assessment procedure
controls.evidence: No conformity assessment has been performed. Listing this as a gap is the point: a repository can produce the technical evidence an assessment consumes and cannot perform the assessment on itself.
